summary_text: Per 16 analysts, average rating for ROK is 'Buy' with 12-month price target of $406.2 (a -0.30% decrease from latest price). 15 buys, 2 holds, 0 sells. Alternate dataset of 14 analysts shows 'Buy' consensus and avg PT $414.64 (3.05% upside). ROK moved up 10.72% on May 5, 2026 driven by stronger-than-expected fiscal Q2 2026 earnings beat and raised FY26 guidance — both adjusted EPS and revenue surpassed consensus.
